title: Atomwaffen Division – 2018 Ukraine travel and Pact of Steel conference (Kyiv)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

This is a request under the Freedom of Information Act, 5 U.S.C. § 552.

I request records from January 1, 2018, through December 31, 2018, concerning:

Travel by members or associates of Atomwaffen Division (AWD) to Ukraine (including Kyiv);

Any attendance at, involvement with, or reporting on the Pact of Steel conference (or related events such as Asgardsrei) in Kyiv in 2018;

Any related FBI investigative reports, communications, surveillance records, or confidential human source activity connected to those trips or events; and

Any records of payments, expense authorizations, or authorizations for otherwise illegal activity tied to such travel or events within AWD investigations during that period.

Please search the Central Records System (CRS) and any other relevant systems or field-office holdings. Provide all reasonably segregable non-exempt portions. I request that any withholdings be justified by specific exemption citations and that a Vaughn index (or equivalent) be provided for any fully withheld records.

I request a fee waiver under 5 U.S.C. § 552(a)(4)(A)(iii). Disclosure of these records is in the public interest because it concerns the operations and activities of the federal government (specifically, the FBI’s handling of investigations into Atomwaffen Division, transnational travel by members of the group, and the use of confidential human sources in that context). The information is likely to contribute to public understanding of these operations, and I have no commercial interest in the records. I am prepared to pay reasonable fees up to $25 if the waiver is denied; please notify me in advance of any estimated costs exceeding that amount.

Please provide the records in electronic format if available. My contact information is: Christina Urso, 8409 Manassas Cir, Vienna, VA 22180, email: radixverum29@protonmail.com.

Thank you for your attention to this request.

Sincerely,

Christina L. Urso

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Christina L. Urso
